name: joltphysics
description: Jolt Physics as Automap builds it: the joltphysics port with Jolt's external profile hooks, and double precision and cross-platform determinism as features. vcpkg's features must be additive; these aren't, so they live in the Automap registry, and a composition takes at most one build of Jolt.

debugrenderer.description: Enable debug renderer in Debug and Release builds

deterministic.description: Cross-platform determinism (CROSS_PLATFORM_DETERMINISTIC): the same simulation gives the same results on every platform, at some cost in speed

double-precision.description: Double precision world positions (DOUBLE_PRECISION): RVec3 becomes DVec3
